message.jaymospowers.blindness.sky_sight: Sky Sight on. You see yourself from far above.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.carve_war: Again, to carve out your eyes. There is no undoing it.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.sockets_b: The sockets won't stop bleeding. Bandage your eyes or bleed out.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.sockets_h: The sockets have closed over. Your eyes are not coming back.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.service.h: %s turns their bound face toward you and says nothing. Not now.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.service.c: What the eye takes in, it lies about.
Give up the liar, and be shown the truth of things.
Are you ready to stop looking, and begin to see?
message.jaymospowers.blindness.service.b: Bind it tight, or the dark will drink you before it fills you.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.service.t: I... I can feel you. All of you. Thank you.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.service.g: You watched. Then this is yours, for when you are ready.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.service.s: No! Not now, not like this!
message.jaymospowers.blindness.service.c: Then be still, and let the dark be tied on.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.service.b: There. Never take it off, not for anyone.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.service.t: It's so dark. It's so kind. Thank you.
message.jaymospowers.unseeing.madness: It's in the dark with me. I hear it. I HEAR you!
message.jaymospowers.unseeing.creed.1: The sun is a great eye, and it has been lying to you since the day you were born.
message.jaymospowers.unseeing.creed.2: Colours are a rumour. Ask anyone who has stopped looking.
message.jaymospowers.unseeing.creed.3: The seven are painted faces, and the Truth is a book with no letters in it.
message.jaymospowers.unseeing.creed.4: When everyone is blind, no one can be watched. That is the kingdom we're building.
message.jaymospowers.unseeing.creed.5: My mother cast me out for this. She'll understand when her eyes go too.
message.jaymospowers.unseeing.creed.6: Mirrors are doors. Don't open them.
message.jaymospowers.unseeing.creed.7: The dark has a voice, if you're quiet. It knows your name. It knew it first.
message.jaymospowers.unseeing.creed.8: You still have them, don't you. I can hear them moving.
message.jaymospowers.scar.left_eye: Your left eye is gone. That side of the world is dark.
message.jaymospowers.scar.right_eye: Your right eye is gone. That side of the world is dark.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.blind: You cannot see. Listen: every sound near you shows on the dark.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.carve_oth: Again, to carve out %s's eyes. There is no undoing it.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.carve_vic: %s is holding shears over your eyes.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.now_reson: Blindness is no longer a power. What you learned in the dark is Resonance now.
message.jaymospowers.blindness.vigil_kep: The dark has settled on you. Keep the blindfold on and strike a tuning fork.
